claims.text: ABRS: may use nasal saline irrigation (± analgesics, INCS) for Sx relief (option)
claims.quote: Clinicians may recommend analgesics, topical intranasal steroids, and/or nasal saline irrigation for symptomatic relief of ABRS.
claims.locator: Clinical Practice Guideline: Adult Sinusitis Update (AAO-HNSF, 2025), key action statements as reproduced by Guideline Central

claims.text: Viral RS: same, for Sx relief (option)
claims.quote: Clinicians may recommend analgesics, topical intranasal steroids, and/or nasal saline irrigation for symptomatic relief of VRS.
claims.locator: Clinical Practice Guideline: Adult Sinusitis Update (AAO-HNSF, 2025), key action statements as reproduced by Guideline Central

claims.text: CRS: saline nasal irrigation, INCS, or both for Sx relief (recommendation)
claims.quote: Clinicians should recommend saline nasal irrigation, topical intranasal corticosteroids, or both for symptom relief of CRS.
claims.locator: Clinical Practice Guideline: Adult Sinusitis Update (AAO-HNSF, 2025), key action statements as reproduced by Guideline Central
